title: DUOS TECHNOLOGIES GROUP, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: DUOT), a small-cap technology company based in Jacksonville, Florida, filed an 8-K reporting a CEO transition on April 1, 2026. Douglas Recker was appointed CEO and President, succeeding Charles Ferry who resigned but remains as a Director. The equity award for the departing CEO was amended, reducing the share grant from 552,889 to 261,445 shares with vesting conditions adjusted.
key_points: Douglas Recker appointed CEO and President effective April 1, 2026
Charles Ferry resigned as CEO but continues as Director of the Company
Ferry retains role as CEO of New APR Energy, LLC (5% equity interest held by Duos)
Original equity award of 552,889 shares reduced to 261,445 shares via amendment
Vesting date remains December 31, 2027; forfeiture condition changed from employment to directorship status
Company is listed on Nasdaq with trading symbol DUOT
